units.source_text: 行至打出海边，传闻源氏公子一行已经越过粟田山。

en.t: When they reached the shore at Uchiide, word came that Prince Genji's party had already crossed Mount Awata.

units.source_text: 这里还来不及避让，公子的前驱者已经蜂拥而至了。

en.t: Before they had time to move aside, the prince's outriders came swarming up.

units.source_text: 于是常陆守一行人等只得在关山地方下车，

en.t: So the governor of Hitachi and his party had no choice but to get down from their carriages near Sekiyama,

units.source_text: 把车子驱进各处的杉木林中，卸了牛，支起车辕，人都躲在杉木底下，

en.t: drive the carriages into the cedar groves here and there, unhitch the oxen, prop up the shafts, and hide beneath the cedars,

units.source_text: 仰望源氏公子一行经过。

en.t: looking up as Prince Genji's procession passed by.

units.source_text: 伊豫介一行人的车子，有的还在后面，有的已经先行。

en.t: Some of Iyo no Suke's party's carriages were still behind, while others had already gone on ahead.

units.source_text: 然而眷属为数甚多，这里也还有十辆车子，

en.t: But because their household was very large, there were still ten carriages here as well,

units.source_text: 各色各样的女衫襟袖，露出在车帘底下，

en.t: with collars and sleeves of women's robes in many colors showing beneath the carriage blinds,

units.source_text: 一望而知乘在车里的不是乡下女子。

en.t: so that one could tell at a glance that the women inside were not country women.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，觉得这很像斋宫下伊势时出来看热闹的游览车。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw them, he thought they looked much like the sightseeing carriages that came out when the High Priestess went down to Ise.

units.source_text: 源氏公子重新获得了世所罕有的尊荣富贵，

en.t: Prince Genji had once again attained honor and splendor rarely seen in the world,

units.source_text: 因此前驱之人多不胜数。

en.t: and so his outriders were too numerous to count.

units.source_text: 他们都注目这十辆女车。

en.t: They all fixed their attention on these ten women's carriages.
